title: Indian-Style Syrian Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish with a mix of Syrian and Indian spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the nutty flavor of Syrian rice with the warm spices of India.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add curry powder and cumin; cook for 1 minute.
Add rice and stir to coat with spices.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
